method: Read frozen implementation, test code and worker receipts; independently try a specific concurrent-state counterexample using isolated loopback HTTP and a contract-fake provider. No production sources changed or external provider called. Model/reasoning inherited; read-only is an instruction and OS enforcement was not verified.

finding.severity: medium for the contract-fake path and future live enablement; actual paid Anthropic transport is currently disabled by Runtime.__init__ lines 475–478
finding.observed: After _current checks the bound music and the message attempt is marked submitted within BEGIN IMMEDIATE, that transaction commits and releases its lock before transport.complete is invoked. An audio upload can commit in this interval; the previously approved message body is nevertheless handed to the transport.
finding.independent_reproduction: Construct MusicInputContextTest isolated fixture with python3 -B, upload synthetic 3-second audio, create and approve a search_project_context follow preview for version 1, wrap the contract-fake transport.complete so it uploads synthetic 4-second audio before delegating to the original complete, and call process_next. Observed processed=True, accepted_audio=1, current_audio=2, transport_messages=2, last_sent_approved_body=True, turn_status=outcome_unknown. The first transport record was the initial tool request; the second was the stale continuation. The complete wrapper injects the upload after the pre-send check/transaction and before the fake transport records the message. Loopback fixture and temporary data only; no external AI request.
finding.impact: The exact previously approved body is preserved but the stronger requested invariant—do not newly transmit a stale continuation after the project's music changes—does not hold in this scheduling window. Post-response revalidation cannot recall an already handed-off request. The fixture ended outcome_unknown, which does not prove a paid charge or live transmission.
finding.counterexample_to_existing_test: tests/test_music_input_context.py:294–311 mutates during count and exercises the second _current check, but does not mutate after that check and before transport.complete.
finding.resolution_direction: Define and enforce a submission linearization contract coordinated with project music mutations, and separately preserve accurate unknown/attempt and cost behavior. A second uncoordinated state read alone leaves a new race window. Retest both same-project audio/range mutation and unrelated-project progress without real provider calls.

surviving_observations.claim: Projection separates selected source, timeline source and confirmed range and only exposes validated duration and categorical rights state in music_input.
surviving_observations.limit: Reading and worker fixture evidence; not an assertion that unrelated project-context fields are globally free of all user text.

surviving_observations.claim: Follow-up marker is manifest-bound and compares the persisted run/call result, disclosed tool-result body and current music projection.
surviving_observations.limit: Does not eliminate the later transaction-to-transport race in the finding. Older messages are retained as history and latest trusted receipt replaces the marker.

surviving_observations.claim: Prompt-only preview after an upload can query current audio, and stale continuation is rejected during decision, before count, and when the audio changes during count.
surviving_observations.limit: Worker's log says 13 tests passed; reviewer did not rerun the suite. Count-boundary evidence does not cover the later scheduling gap.

surviving_observations.claim: Code checks manifest, body digests, wire digests for live-style transport, price and budget binding and preserves uncertain reservation handling.
surviving_observations.limit: Code inspection only for full cost/idempotency behavior; no exhaustive ledger regression run by reviewer.

evidence_interpretation: audio-change-manifest-observation.json records an earlier baseline in which a stale continuation was sent; it must not be described as a passing result for the modified build.
http-responses.json records isolated actual loopback HTTP with contract-fake provider and zero external provider calls; it is not evidence of live Claude behavior.
final-13.log records worker execution of 13 tests and OK. No duplicate full suite was executed independently.
The supplied raw DB tampered-duration state.preflight crash is an existing separate corruption boundary and was not expanded or retested in this task.
No real user acceptance, production provider behavior, or comprehensive absence of other defects is established.

followup_correction_20261028.supersedes: The finding's expressions 'before transport.complete is invoked', 'approved stale continuation after change' as a proven approval bypass, and its severity classification are withdrawn. The earlier experiment uploaded inside a patched complete wrapper, after complete was invoked and after the current message attempt had been committed. The preserved original text is an audit record, not the current verdict.
followup_correction_20261028.transaction_order: _current, current-round message-attempt claim, and submitted=True occur in the same BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction at chat_general.py:528–537; that transaction commits before transport.complete at line 539. The injected change was inside the entered wrapper before delegation to the fake transport's original method, not before the complete call. It is after committed submission intent, although before that fake records the approved body. This does not demonstrate a pre-submission stale approval bypass.
followup_correction_20261028.linearization: The code implements an atomic current-state check plus message-attempt claim that can serve as a local submission-intent linearization point. The inspected code and targeted report do not explicitly establish that as an agreed product contract. Atomicity cannot extend to a remote provider merely by this DB transaction; edits after this point can race an already authorized in-flight request. No requirement was established to lock the whole project for network duration.
followup_correction_20261028.prior_round_caution: turn.submitted persists across rounds, so submitted=True alone is not proof that the current round was submitted. Identify the current reservation and message attempt as well. In the independent pre-submission-count case submitted remained true from the previous round even though no current-round message attempt was created.

after_commit_response_observed.fixture: isolated HTTP and contract-fake provider; synthetic audio; no external calls
after_commit_response_observed.at_complete_entry: submitted=true, status=running, current reservation=reserved, one earlier message recorded
after_commit_response_observed.change: upload synthetic audio version 2 after wrapper entry
after_commit_response_observed.transmission: original fake transport recorded exact approved version-1 body; message count 2
after_commit_response_observed.response: fake returned a propose_media_plan tool use; post-response _current detected the new music; no additional production run tool call, no guided plan
after_commit_response_observed.ledger: response usage observed and priced in fake mode; current reservation settled with actual 60 micro-units. Turn status outcome_unknown and billing_confirmed=false. This is not an unknown reservation; observed-fake-usage and unknown turn are distinct.

before_submission_change.fixture: independent isolated test changed audio version 1 to 2 during follow-up count, before the current-round message claim
before_submission_change.result: blocked_before_message; message count remains 1; current reservation cancelled with actual=null; no new chat-message attempt. Prior-round submitted flag remains true and must not be misread.

after_commit_no_response.fixture: independent isolated test changed audio inside complete wrapper and raised TimeoutError without a response
after_commit_no_response.result: outcome_unknown; current reservation uncertain, actual=null, original amount 2458 micro-units held; newest chat-message attempt unknown; no additional fake message recorded. This is a fake failure injection, not proof of real billing.

followup_correction_20261028.current_verdict: No independently demonstrated high/medium stale-approval bypass in the pre-submission boundary. The previously reported scheduling behavior remains a concrete post-claim in-flight case, not proof of a defect under a submission-intent linearization contract. No blanket no-defect or production-readiness claim follows.
followup_correction_20261028.minimal_next_step: Document or confirm the submission-intent boundary and add targeted regression assertions for current-reservation attempt identity, a pre-claim change, post-claim change with a tool response, and post-claim timeout with uncertain hold. Avoid locking normal project editing for network duration. A stronger guarantee that no provider receives older context after any later edit would require a separate explicit contract and feasibility/design decision.
followup_correction_20261028.limits: Real live transport remains disabled in Runtime.__init__; no external provider request, real charge, complete suite rerun, or actual user testing occurred. The separate DB corruption limit remains unchanged.
